_comment: sim-robust-place-descent-plan-v1. Purpose: let the COLLECT place descent actually COMPLETE after the PR 209 upright preplace. PR 211 (sim-robust-cart-place-descent-v1) tolerated the ~cm descent-reaction base shove at the MISSION stationary guard (runtime.py `not p.parked`). But the sensor-owning host runtime ALSO feeds packet.parked into the station channel's OWN parking gate (native_channel.StationClient.tick: `if not parked: raise ValueError('station lost measured parking')`), and PR 211 left THAT path getting the raw packet.parked. collect3 (PR 211 active) therefore STILL failed: the place reached the upright preplace (z=0.608) and was descending onto the deck (gripper gap 31->15 mm) when a 25.7 mm base shove (well inside the 0.08 m settle tol) flipped packet.parked False; the mission guard tolerated it but self.manip.step passed parked=False to the station gate -> MANIP_STEP_EXCEPTION 'station lost measured parking' -> the step returned failed/'host' (this is the 'phase=host' in the evidence; the host never took over), the arm never placed/released/stowed, and every re-begin then failed 'arm command heartbeat lost' (arm_not_in_transport). The fix presents the station/host parking gate the SAME effective-parked verdict the mission guard reached, during the loaded collect place only.
_no_new_key: This fix introduces NO new config key. It is wired to the EXISTING PR 211 `collect_place_base_settle_m` (RUNTIME): whenever that tolerance accepts the bounded loaded-place shove, the runtime now also feeds the station gate parked=True that tick. With the key OFF (absent/0) the strict guard fails FIRST and the raw parked never reaches the gate => byte-identical, and the scripted/still transfer path (collect_place_base_settle_m is collect-scoped) is untouched.
_runtime_block: Merge into the mission RUNTIME config block (read by scripts/twin/restock/isaac_bundle.py -> RuntimeAdapter, the orchestrate process). SAME value as the PR 211 fragment -- no change, no addition.
_collect_place_base_settle_m_note: Metres. Unchanged from sim-robust-cart-place-descent-v1. collect3 shoved 25.7 mm; 0.08 covers it with margin and is far inside the 0.25 m ground-truth place-verify xy tol. A base pushed BEYOND this bound still fails with the PR 211 NAMED reason BEFORE manip.step, so the station gate never sees a runaway. See docs/examples/cart-place-descent-mission-fragment.json for the full key note.
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json). Unchanged from the PR 211 fragment; the release-detach budget still bounds a non-detaching release once the descent completes.
_requires: The HOST block must already carry the PR 209 upright place-goal keys (collect_place_preplace_shape + collect_place_wrist_guard) and reposition_before_place:true with cart_cage_place:false; the RUNTIME block the PR 211 collect_place_base_settle_m. This fix needs NO additional --require preflight key.
_bounded_gpu_proof: Run the COLLECT3 STAGING UNCHANGED (GROUND-TRUTH collect RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1, TRANSFER_MODE=scripted, cage_collision filtered, transfer_carry weld+wrist_guard, PR 203/208/209 keys, collect_place_base_settle_m:0.08 RUNTIME, release_detach_timeout_s:8.0 HOST) + couple, through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr; never --force). Expected PASS (vs collect3 FAIL): the place reaches the upright preplace as before, the place DESCENT completes onto the deck WITHOUT 'station lost measured parking' (the ~cm reaction is tolerated at BOTH the mission guard AND the station gate), the gripper-open DETACHES the weld, the ground-truth place verify shows the carton resting on the cart deck, the arm STOWS to the transport pose, transport_ready becomes True, and couple can begin. A base shoved more than 0.08 m still fails with the PR 211 named settle-tolerance reason (before the gate); a non-detaching release still fails fast with release_detach_timeout_s's named reason.
